shared_meta_ensemble_prior_limits_v62.ANIL: Head-only inner adaptation and shared-feature outer meta-updates are direct prior; no new shared-body meta operator.
shared_meta_ensemble_prior_limits_v62.BMAML_EMAML: A shared feature extractor and private ensemble classifiers with head-only inner updates and shared-feature/classifier meta-updates explicitly precede the proposal.
shared_meta_ensemble_prior_limits_v62.Meta_Graph: Link-prediction meta-learning over actual multiple graph tasks is prior. Endpoint blocks in one graph do not inherit independent-task or deployment-distribution guarantees.
shared_meta_ensemble_prior_limits_v62.candidate: Persistent-route recomputation and endpoint-separated raw-logit graph supervision are a conditional composition hypothesis, not cleared novelty or established quality.
shared_meta_ensemble_prior_limits_v62.limits: No native-Adam, ranking, generalization or universal superiority theorem; NCNC detached completion is not admitted under the exact-derivative claim.
shared_meta_ensemble_prior_limits_v62.triage: Only source-feasibility and the method/prior/control/falsification specification retained. No fit, heldout access, frozen-cohort change or predictive adoption.

train_only_shared_core_meta_prior_limits.MLDG: Train-only transfer optimization, deployment without adaptation and gradient-agreement interpretation are direct prior. An extra derivative through an update is not a new learning principle.
train_only_shared_core_meta_prior_limits.MetaReg: Shared features, persistent source-specific heads and differentiable virtual private updates are prior. Feature freezing and final fresh single differ from the candidate; no-inference-adaptation is already established.
train_only_shared_core_meta_prior_limits.graph_candidate: Endpoint-separated correlated queries, served mean-logit/member-competence objective and recomputed persistent weights are unproved recipe differences requiring adapted-single, untied-ensemble, detached-credit and matched-random-separation controls.
train_only_shared_core_meta_prior_limits.limits: No unbiased cross-fitting, independent task distribution, novelty, native-Adam, ranking/generalization or predictive-superiority guarantee. Native sparse derivative failure is an implementation limit, not disproof of the hypothesis.

graph_update_and_persistent_sharing_prio.LPSFed: Repeated user-item client learning shares pooled/predictive MLP parameters by averaging and structural-similarity interpolation; no differentiated outer query through private learning in saved scope.
graph_update_and_persistent_sharing_prio.PFedEG: Repeated local KG learners share personalized supplementary entity embedding mixtures and proximity regularization; embedding-affinity recomputation is not itself a private-update meta-gradient.
graph_update_and_persistent_sharing_prio.TMetaNet: Topology-conditioned scalar rates update full dynamic GNN weights. Inspected snapshots/rate scopes do not specify persistent private ensemble credit or current outer endpoint-union exclusion.
graph_update_and_persistent_sharing_prio.boundary: These scopes add graph update-map and persistent client-sharing ancestry. No exact endpoint-rule match found in them, no global absence proof, no ensemble-specific sharing mechanism or supported successor. Frozen cohort/controls unchanged.
graph_update_and_persistent_sharing_prio.decision_notes: Counterfactual-credit algebra and the method decision are hashed optional analysis notes in SOURCE_BINDINGS; they add zero paper identities or primary/full-paper reads.

AUX_TS.deployment: The selected method optimizes a target-task GNN and task-specific heads. Persistent raw-logit ensemble serving without adaptation is not specified; deployment implementation was not read.
AUX_TS.episode_geometry: Algorithm1 line5 splits supervised batch into train/meta folds. No endpoint-based split or both-positive-and-negative endpoint exclusion is specified in selected methods.
AUX_TS.learning_credit: Eqs7–8/Algorithm1 lines11–12 differentiate target loss through a virtual joint GNN update to weighting-model parameters w. The meta variable is w, not the shared GNN theta; no private-only inner map is specified.
AUX_TS.private_state: Auxiliary task-specific layers are named, but persistent same-task private learner rows and separate optimizer histories are not specified.
AUX_TS.recomputed_commit: Algorithm1 lines14–19 recompute similarity/joint loss at original theta_t using updated w_(t+1), then update persistent theta. Actual update uses full Dsup plus Daux, including the meta fold. This directly establishes generic graph recomputation order and differs from the candidate private inner-only recomputation.
AUX_TS.shared_core: §3.1 explicitly shares GNN parameters across target and auxiliary task-specific layers. It does not specify the candidate shared dense predictor basis/private-factor decomposition.

TMAG.deployment: §3.2 explicitly updates parameters on meta-test support and evaluates query. §4.5 says new-user/item representations are rapidly adapted. This differs from the candidate adaptation-free served ensemble.
TMAG.episode_geometry: §4.2.2 clusters users with K-means and makes support/query mutually exclusive as interaction sets. §4.3.3 Eq14 uses observed and unobserved user-item pairs. Pair-set disjointness does not entail exclusion of both endpoints of all positive and negative query pairs. The exact exclusion is not specified.
TMAG.learning_credit: §4.5 Eqs17–18 and Algorithm1 lines9–12 give support inner learning followed by query second-order meta update to initial parameters. A private-only inner/shared-only outer state partition is not specified.
TMAG.private_state: §3.2 and §4.5 describe learning an initial parameter and adapting it to tasks/new users/items. Algorithm1 uses theta_k without explicitly defining its reset/carry rule; persistent same-task private rows/separate Adam histories and served ensemble are not established by the scope.
TMAG.recomputed_commit: Algorithm1 proceeds from global meta update to graph augmentation, line13. No recomputed persistent inner-only private commit from unchanged old private state is specified.
TMAG.shared_core: §4.3 specifies LightGCN-style embedding propagation, attribute concatenation and inner-product prediction. A persistent shared dense predictor basis with private fast factor rows is not specified.

TMAG_unresolved_details: Algorithm theta_k initialization/carry convention is not explicitly defined in selected algorithm; no author code inspected.
Attribute-oriented autoencoder §4.2.1 and Eq2–5 not read; Algorithm1 references Eq5.
Experimental split proportions, evaluation implementation and published outcomes were not inspected.
graph_endpoint_private_update_prior_limi.allowed_statement: In the checked saved and two new bounded scopes, the full active conjunction was not established. The positive+negative endpoint eligibility and exact persistent shared/private commit/serving configuration can be described precisely as the configuration studied. This does not establish historical or substantive novelty.
interpretation_limits: Current endpoint exclusion changes current inner-label eligibility, not historical exposure or retained graph context.
No independence, unseen-node transfer, or inference-adaptation task distribution is inferred.
Optimizer replay details and the half/half BCE objective do not by themselves establish novelty.
graph_endpoint_private_update_prior_limi.scope_limits: Two bounded saved method scopes, zero full-paper reads; reused H-GRAM/Meta-iKG and all metadata leads earn zero new credit. No global absence/novelty clearance or utility/execution verdict.
